newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 29.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 29.

text.p: -- National Semiconductor Corp agreed to acquire Cyrix Corp in a stock swap valued at $550 million. Cyrix shareholders would receive 0.825 share of National Semiconductor for each Cyrix share. National Semiconductor closed at 33-7/16. Cyrix closed at 23-1/16, then rose as much as two points in after-hours trading.

-- Advanced Micro Devices cut prices on its K6 computer chips by as much as 55 percent, while microprocessor giant Intel Corp cut its chip prices by as much as 57 percent. AMD closed at 35-3/8. Intel finished at 88-9/16.
-- Gateway 2000 Inc said its president and chief operating officer Richard Snyder was leaving his posts to lead an entrepreneurial venture capital fund. The stock closed at 39-11/16.

-- A U.S. Food and Drug Administration advisory committee voted to reject PLC Systems Inc's heart laser system for the treatment of chronic chest pain that does not respond to angioplasty or coronary artery bypass surgery. The stock closed at 25-10/16.
